methodology_adjudication.conflict_resolved: Addendum Item 3 says 'measure extstab seconds'; the harness doc (Whisper C4971) says raw extstab wall-time is a sampler-config artifact (Metropolis mixing x shots), NOT Clifford+T hardness, and must not be curved (G1 strawman).
methodology_adjudication.resolution: The rank curve is fundamentally PAPER-PINNED in shape (Bravyi-Gosset gamma=0.23 sampling); the absolute bill = anchor(3h @ n40,t48) x 2^(0.23(t-48)) x (t/48)^3 x (n/40)^3 / edge_speedup. The only load-bearing free parameter is edge_speedup, and it is genuinely uncertain UPWARD (a real optimized GF(2)/all-core stabilizer solver could beat any dense float proxy several-fold).
methodology_adjudication.why_not_naive_extstab_at_t64_80: At t>=64 an actual extstab solve is hours+ on a box SHARED with Whisper/Ember (C4415 saturation hazard) AND its wall-time is sampler-inflated -> would measure the wrong thing. NEITHER a dense proxy NOR a harness extstab row cleanly yields the rank per-term intercept (extstab run_s is sampler seconds, not the InnerProduct op). The rank intercept stays an implementation BAND, labeled.
